summary: soispoke 发文说明 FOCIL 与 frame 交易如何配合：FOCIL 用廉价的 nonce 与余额检查判断被遗漏的包含列表交易，这对 EOA 有效，但原生 AA 的有效性需要执行 VERIFY frame，因此要定义一个可进公共内存池的 FrameTx 子集。shemnon 提交 CATX，把交易体与签名分离以便迁移后量子签名。ACDT #74 讨论 ePBS 与 BAL 的 devnet。

items.topic: 原生 AA：FOCIL 与 frame 交易
items.title: soispoke：鉴于 Hegotá 讨论哪个执行层头号提案与 FOCIL 一起上线，发文说明 FOCIL 与 frame 交易如何配合
items.note: 18:08；Magicians 原文：FOCIL 用基于执行后状态的 nonce 与余额检查判断被遗漏的包含列表交易，这对 EOA 有效，但原生 AA 交易需执行 VERIFY frame 才能判定有效，因此定义可进公共内存池的 FrameTx 子集，在执行后状态上限定 VERIFY 执行，并为每个包含列表设 VERIFY gas 预算以限制 attester 工作量。
items.title_en: soispoke: given the Hegotá discussion on which EL headliner ships with FOCIL, a post on how FOCIL and frame transactions interact
items.note_en: 18:08; the Magicians post: FOCIL checks omitted inclusion list transactions with a nonce and balance check against post state, which works for EOAs, but native AA transactions need VERIFY frames executed to judge validity, so it defines a public mempool eligible FrameTx subset with bounded VERIFY execution against post state and a per list VERIFY gas budget to cap attester work.
items.topic_en: Native AA: FOCIL and frame transactions

items.title: 新增 EIP：加密敏捷交易
items.note: （shemnon）提交；Magicians：EIP-8197 CATX 23:11：EIP-2718 交易格式，把交易体与签名分开，签名按位置承诺，支持多签与未来的 ZK 签名聚合，也适用于 EIP-8141 frame 交易。
items.note_en: (shemnon), submitted; Magicians: EIP-8197 CATX, 23:11: an EIP-2718 format separating the body from signatures, with each signature committing to its position, supporting multisig and future ZK signature aggregation, and usable for EIP-8141 frame transactions.

summary_en: soispoke explained how FOCIL and frame transactions interact: FOCIL judges omitted inclusion list transactions with a cheap nonce and balance check, which works for EOAs but not native AA, where validity requires executing VERIFY frames, so a public mempool eligible FrameTx subset is defined. shemnon submitted CATX, separating the transaction body from signatures to ease post-quantum migration. ACDT #74 covered the ePBS and BAL devnets.
